rows.ARS:
White, near white or white blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: Guesrave
Exhibition name: Pure Delight
rows.Origin:
Bred by Maurice Guest (United Kingdom, 2013).
Introduced in United Kingdom by C & K Jones in 2013 as 'Pure Delight'.
rows.Bloom: Cream, peach shading, cream reverse. None to mild fragrance. Average diameter 4.5". Large, full (26-40 petals), borne mostly solitary, exhibition bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit: Medium, bushy. Medium, semi-glossy, medium green foliage.
rows.Growing: Can be used for beds and borders, cut flower, exhibition or garden.
rows.Parentage:
Unnamed Seedling ×
Belle Époque (hybrid tea, Fryer before 1993)
